newsitem.title: UK: ALLIANCE & LEICESTER REVIEWING MORTGAGE RATES.
newsitem.headline: ALLIANCE & LEICESTER REVIEWING MORTGAGE RATES.

text.p: Recently-floated home loans group Alliance and Leicester Plc said on Thursday it was reviewing its mortgage rates after the Bank of England raised interest rates.

A spokeswoman said the Alliance might come to a decision later today whether or not to adjust its rates. Britain's central bank increased its official interest rates to 7.0 percent from 6.75 percent, the fourth increase in as many months.
Alliance last increased its mortage rate on July 10 to 8.2 percent from 7.95 percent. -- London Newsroom + 44 171 542 7717
